summary: Powell County, MT lookout site on the Flathead NF; firelookout.com dates an L-4 cab to 1936 and abandonment to 1955; Forest Lookouts marks it removed; no present-day description found.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone and marked removed on the Forest Lookouts page; no source describes what remains

evidence.supports: location: about 15 miles north-northeast of Seeley Lake, Powell County, Montana, Flathead National Forest
forest: Flathead National Forest, same as firelookout.com
county: Powell County, the heading above the Cardinal Peak record on the Forest Lookouts page
Forest Lookouts marks the site as removed
ground lookout, coordinates 47.38000 -113.36790, listed as gone

notes_for_editor: Dates (1936 cab, 1955 abandonment) come only from firelookout.com. The Forest Lookouts page marks the site 'Removed' with no date. Two web searches found nothing on Cardinal Peak in the Seeley Lake area and no account of staffing, fires or the present site. The 8,551-foot elevation is recorded only in the story, not in facts, because the facts schema has no elevation key.
